meta.source: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), product and UPI ecosystem statistics, captured by the local Data Bank
meta.vintageNote: NPCI publishes no revision date for its statistics and edits past rows in place without notice; these are its tables as the Data Bank captured them on the archiveCapturedDate.
meta.revisionPolicy: NPCI edits past rows in place without notice (it revised April 2023's UPI volume, and NETC's February and March 2026 in October 2026). Each capture is the table as NPCI then showed it; the Data Bank keeps every capture.
meta.coverage: e-RUPI, prepaid single-purpose vouchers redeemed by a QR code or SMS, each month since September 2022: vouchers created and redeemed, by government scheme to December 2023 and by issuing bank from January 2024
meta.note: NPCI's rows change meaning: government voucher schemes and a total to December 2023, issuing banks from January 2024 with no total. Spellings of one bank in different months (HDFC, HDFC Bank, HDFC Bank Ltd; ICICI Bank, ICICI Bank Ltd; Yes Bank, Yes Bank Ltd) are one line here; the original spellings are in sourceLabel. February 2024 repeats January 2024 for every bank but one; kept as printed. One July 2023 cell NPCI's spreadsheet turned into a date is left out by the Data Bank.
